summary: Phase 6B Duplicate Detection Engine — formal backend verification. 28/28 pytest cases pass against the public EXPO_BACKEND_URL against the demo admin. Full coverage of the 7 requested test areas plus a regression sweep (Phase 6A onboarding, existing AMASS-LAG-00000001 listings, /agent-platform/plans, /agent/score, /crm/leads, legacy POST /api/properties). No defects found in duplicate_detection.py or the submit gate in property_identity.py. Admin threshold config restored to defaults (possible=60, high_confidence=80) at test end.

minor.issue: The threshold config is global and mutable at runtime. Any parallel test worker or concurrent admin session can race on it (observed with pytest-xdist). Not a code defect — but consider adding an ETag / optimistic-concurrency token, or documenting that admin config is single-tenant global state so callers coordinate. Test file has been written to run reliably in serial mode (`-o addopts=''`).

When called for a draft whose seeded existing candidate has sparse `details` (bathrooms/size null), the max attainable score is ~45. That is correct behaviour, but it means the default 60-point `possible_threshold` cannot actually trigger the gate for the Phase 6A seed alone. Consider back-filling seeded `properties_geo` with bathrooms & building_size_sqm so duplicate-gate behaviour is reproducible without threshold tweaks in demos.

action_items: None required. Phase 6B is production-ready from a backend verification standpoint.
Optional: seed AMASS-LAG-00000001 with bathrooms + building_size_sqm so the default 60 threshold can trigger the gate without admin tweaks.
Optional: consider persisting per-admin overrides / audit rows on PATCH /api/admin/duplicate/config for traceability (currently just $set + updated_at).
critical_code_review_comments: duplicate_detection.py cleanly separates scoring (pure functions) from HTTP routes — good testability.
Submit gate in property_identity.py correctly imports duplicate_detection._load_config lazily (guarded with try/except fallback to defaults) — no circular import risk.

Attach-to-existing path (decision=same_property) correctly reuses canonical property_uuid + amass_property_id and stamps `attached_via_duplicate_decision:true` on the new listing, and writes a `LISTING_ATTACHED_TO_EXISTING` audit row.
Idempotent submit works for BOTH paths — attached and newly-created — via draft-stored property_id/listing_id lookup.
Admin threshold guardrails (possible >= 40, high_confidence >= 60) are enforced correctly.
GPS multiplier: search_radius = max(cfg.search_radius, accuracy * 2). Proximity slack scales with accuracy for weak GPS — verified.
No MongoDB `_id` leaks in any Phase 6B response (all endpoints project `{_id:0}`).
Suggested small enhancement: on PATCH admin config, echo back the resulting full config (currently returns `{ok:true, updated:[…]}`) — clients have to re-GET to confirm.
seed_data_creation: Test file creates transient drafts + non-admin user under prefix nonadmin_<hex>@example.com; no cleanup done (Phase 6A pattern). The Phase 6A fixture AMASS-LAG-00000001 was preserved. During TestSubmitGate.test_same_property_attaches the demo agent creates ONE additional listing attached to AMASS-LAG-00000001 each run (existing:2 → after tests:3+). Consider cleanup in a future iteration if listing counts start to matter.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To reproduce serially: `cd /app/backend && EXPO_BACKEND_URL=... python -m pytest tests/test_phase6b_duplicate.py -v -o addopts=''`. Do NOT run under pytest-xdist parallel mode — admin threshold config is global state, causing false-negative races in TestSubmitGate.test_409_when_no_decision. All threshold mutations are wrapped in try/finally to restore defaults.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects found in Phase 6B code. Two transient test failures during iteration were test-only issues: (a) legacy POST /api/properties required additional fields (size_sqm, location, latitude, longitude); (b) with the sparse Phase 6A seed, max achievable duplicate score at the fixture coordinate is ~45 so the default 60 threshold could not gate the submit — the test now temporarily lowers possible_threshold to 40 to force the 409 gate, then restores it. Both fixed in-file.
